decision.reason: [ev-3401df3ccc78] is only a link titled "API endpoint deprecations" that points to an external API reference section that isn't shown. It names no endpoint, no replacement and no removal timeline. The rest of the section ([ev-ef5cca6f9d3b], [ev-d76b5a54d0e6]) covers unrelated storage and configuration deprecations and adds nothing about API endpoints. To write the subject, change and applicability, we need the content of the linked deprecated-endpoints list: which endpoints are deprecated and what replaces each. That list may also contain several separate changes.
